_comment: Ceilings (the roof seen from inside, in the Inside and Eye views). `finishes` are the ceiling designs, `paints` its colours. Prices in AED, paid once by whoever changes it. The first of each is what every home comes with.

finishes.label: Flat plaster & downlights
finishes.desc: Smooth white plaster with recessed spotlights.

finishes.label: Tray ceiling & cove light
finishes.desc: A dropped border round a raised centre, lit by a warm hidden LED strip.

finishes.label: Coffered grid
finishes.desc: Deep square panels framed by moulded beams, like a grand hotel.

finishes.label: Exposed timber beams
finishes.desc: Dark walnut beams across the room for a warm, rustic feel.

finishes.label: Arabesque gold medallions
finishes.desc: Gilded eight-point star medallions in hand-cast plaster.

finishes.label: Starlight sky ceiling
finishes.desc: Hundreds of fibre-optic stars twinkling overhead. Best in a dark colour.
